summary: NDR feed c089_broker_nic is severely degraded by packet loss: BROKER-A port 5 discarding 23.24% (56,755,680 pkts) at 100% avg 10G load with higher bursts, plus NDR eth1 discarding 4.68% (8,775,480 pkts) on capture. NDR is missing ~27% of traffic and cannot provide complete detection.

findings.root_cause: BROKER-A port 5 (to NDR) is oversubscribed - average load 100% of 10 Gbps with bursts higher, causing egress queue drops of 56,755,680 packets (23.24% lost). This is broker output discard before traffic reaches the tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR misses ~1 in 4 packets/flows; bidirectional flow reassembly fails, IDS signatures and anomaly detection miss attacks, forensics incomplete, especially during bursts when attacks likely hide.

params.action_detail: add 1-2x10G tool ports and configure symmetric 5-tuple hashing to NDR cluster

recommended_fix.why: Average load already at line-rate so any burst must drop. Load-balancing the aggregate across multiple 10G tool ports with flow-symmetric hashing keeps both directions of each flow together (required by NDR) while bringing per-port utilization below ~60% and eliminating broker egress drops. Apply selective filtering only after balancing if sustained load still >70%.

findings.root_cause: NDR eth1 capture interface overrun discarding 8,775,480 packets it did receive (4.68% lost) - tool cannot keep up with delivered rate even before broker drops.
findings.impact_on_tool: Even traffic that survives the broker is not analyzed; NDR drops packets internally causing truncated flows, missed detections, and gaps in SIEM/NDR evidence.

params.suggested: add RSS queues, increase capture buffers, enable additional 10G interface via load_balance, or upgrade to 25G NIC/CPU

recommended_fix.why: Tool-side drops indicate capture pipeline bottleneck. Increasing capture capacity and spreading load across multiple interfaces/queues lets NDR ingest the full 10G+ aggregate without loss, required for full-payload NDR analysis.
